comparison.objective: Create two required gaps between three parcels on a continuously moving conveyor.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception, lifting or repositioning, and release of moving parcels while preserving belt occupancy.
comparison.success_condition: All parcels pass the scanner on the belt with measured 5 cm gaps; off-belt, stacked, or missing parcels invalidate.
comparison.reason: Moving-line singulation tests timing and parcel placement. It does not test impact delivery, fracture at a manufactured notch, retained-insert protection, or loose-fragment containment.
